name: eigenbasis-structural-lemmas
description: Three structural lemmas the content/twist eigenbasis closes (verified exact-symbolic; Lean formalization is the follow-up): L1 order-parity = word-length parity (makes the #2496 parity obstruction a theorem); L2 bar-involution↔conjugation duality χ_λ(1/q)=−χ_{λ'}(q) for all n (generalizes the H₃-only proved case, ⇒ the conjugation invariant); L3 framing GF = χ_λ/(1−t·q^{2c}) three-pole rational (corollary of the proved ribbon eigenvalue θ_λ=q^{2c}). Does NOT close the Δ_λ binding gate (content-statistic ansätze refuted; out of scope).

lemmas.L1_order_parity: χ_λ(β) Laurent exponents ≡ (word length) mod 2; proof: Hoefsmit crossing factors are odd Laurent degree.
lemmas.L2_conjugation_duality: χ_λ(𝓑_n−𝓑_p)(1/q) = ε_λ·χ_{λ'}(q), ε_λ∈{±1}, ∀λ⊢n; proof: bar involution q↦q⁻¹ = V_λ≅V_{λ'} intertwiner (sign ε_λ per block; uniformly −1 at n=3).
lemmas.L3_framing_gf: Σ_m t^m χ_λ(β·Δ^{2m}) = χ_λ(β)/(1−t·q^{2c(λ)}); proof: centrality + geometric sum on θ_λ=q^{2c}.

verification_scope.L1: all λ⊢n at n=3 (3 reps) and n=6 (11 reps); trivial rep at n=9 (all-λ symbolic sweep deferred — cost; proof is rep-independent).
verification_scope.L2: all λ⊢n at n=3 (3 reps) and n=6 (11 reps).
verification_scope.L3: framing GF built from the ACTUAL framed difference characters χ_λ(𝓑_n·Δ^{2m})−χ_λ(𝓑_p·Δ^{2m}) for m=0..3 (NOT the assumed θ_λ^m — a genuine, non-tautological check that framing multiplies χ_λ by θ_λ=q^{2c}); cross-corroborated by the `framing_multiplicativity` assertion in chi_content_eigenbasis_probe.py.

does_not_close: per-isotope Δ_λ binding gate (content-statistic refuted, GAP-A-3; a content-based Δ_λ would be a 7th fitted ansatz).
lean_followup: formalize L1–L3 as lemmas in QOU/BraidKnot (L1, L2) and as a one-line corollary of RibbonTwistEigenvalue (L3); blocked this session by firewalled Lean toolchain (release.lean-lang.org).
